findings.finding: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 has weak Steam traction 11 weeks after launch: 3,822 Steam reviews total (1,186 at day 1, 56% positive) and 114 concurrent players on 2026-11-09, implying roughly 115-190k Steam units at $49.99 against SEK 356.3m invested and a SEK 384.6m related-party gaming-rights balance at Q2 — the Q3 report is the first place the company must quantify sales and test that asset.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cold Iron/Aliens news has moved this stock hard both ways: 2025-11-11 Q3 report after the 2025-11-10 Aliens delay -17.9%; launch day 2026-08-26 -8.3%; but the 2026-02-17 SEK 2.05bn non-cash impairment + strategic update closed +26.3% (Yahoo daily bars, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/EG7.ST?range=3y&interval=1d).
findings.original_quote: Spelsläppet har mottagit blandade recensioner ... Samtidigt var 56 procent av 1 186 recensioner på Steam positiva (Finwire/Placera 2026-08-26: 'The release has received mixed reviews ... 56 percent of 1,186 Steam reviews were positive')
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock fell 8.3% on launch day and 32% over 60 days with zero disclosed shorts, and Swedish press openly framed the SEK 356m as 'at stake'. What is not priced is the number itself (units, revenue, write-down size); if the market had a figure the 26 Aug-21 Sep slide would have stopped on a disclosure, and there has been none. Kept small and only mildly negative because an impairment here is non-cash and this name rallied on the last clean-up.
findings.independence: Steam concurrent-player API (114 on 2026-11-09): https://api.steampowered.com/ISteamUserStats/GetNumberOfCurrentPlayers/v1/?appid=3448650 ; Redeye 'mixed reception' note: https://storage.mfn.se/90085559-a82c-4e4d-89ee-5018f2febe23/eg7-comment-on-the-mixed-reception-for-aliens-fireteam-elite-2-post-launch.pdf ; same underlying game, so these corroborate rather than add.

findings.finding: The Nintendo Switch 2 version of Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2, slated for 29 Sep 2026 (inside Q3), was moved to early 2027, so Q3 carries no Switch 2 launch revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Release-timing slips on Cold Iron have been punished (2025-11-11 -17.9% after the 2025-11-10 delay); this one was announced 2026-09-25 evening and the next session closed +0.1%.
findings.original_quote: inklusive lanseringen till Nintendo Switch 2, som nu är planerad till början av 2027 ('including the Nintendo Switch 2 launch, which is now planned for early 2027')
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced — public for six weeks; the only residue is that a model built on the July date would carry Switch 2 units in Q3. Sized near zero accordingly.
findings.independence: Earlier Placera/Finwire copy still cited 29 September, showing the original schedule: https://www.placera.se/telegram/enad-global-7-enad-global-7-faller-efter-stora-spelslappet-20260826

findings.finding: Daybreak is cutting staff at the newly acquired Cold Iron Studios 'per the original plan', which takes a studio cost base consolidated from 18 Aug off forward EBITDA (restructuring charge likely in Q3 adjusted items); headcount in boilerplate fell from ~560 (Aug) to ~535 (Oct).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cost actions have been received well here: the 2026-04-13 SEK 32m realignment preceded the +13.9% Q1 report day (2026-05-07), not separable from the Q1 numbers.
findings.original_quote: Personalneddragningen följer den ursprungliga planen och syftar till att minska studions kostnadsbas samt säkerställa en hållbar verksamhet framåt ('The staff reduction follows the original plan and aims to reduce the studio's cost base and secure a sustainable operation going forward')
findings.why_not_priced: Cost size not disclosed; the run-rate saving and the one-off charge first appear in the Q3 numbers. Small because the market reads the cut as confirming a weak launch as much as a cost win.
findings.independence: Employee counts in the issuer boilerplate: ~560 in the Q2 release (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bb92a351bfb3d2327c815a1e7d8fdbcec&lang=en&src=listed) vs ~535 in the Q3 invitation (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b914deeb7a4142190ef196cd9fbabc2d0&lang=en&src=listed).

findings.finding: Q3 revenue faces a weak comp (Q3 2025 SEK 355.3m, -16.2% organic, a quarter the company called 'relatively quiet' on releases) and Q3 2026 carries four new releases (Denshattack! >100k units + 150k Game Pass players in two weeks, EverQuest Legends, Aliens FE2, Far Far West still at 1,529 concurrent and 33,245 reviews), so y/y revenue growth is likely large.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name sells strong quarters: Q2 2026 (revenue +25%, adj. EBITDA nearly tripled) closed -5.65% on the day (2026-08-19), recovering +7.55% two sessions later.
findings.why_not_priced: No sourced bar exists, so the market cannot be shown to expect the growth; but the price has fallen 32% in 60 days while the company's release slate filled the quarter, so a large y/y top line is not what the tape is pricing. Capped small (bar unsourced; beats sold here).
findings.independence: Q2 report on Denshattack! and Far Far West: https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/a62cb74f1c1c9364bec71918f358a92a8 ; Steam API for Far Far West (appid 3124540): https://store.steampowered.com/api/appdetails?appids=3124540&cc=US

findings.finding: Q3 operating cash flow will absorb the SEK 51.5m Far Far West royalty payout the company flagged in the Q2 report, reversing Q2's working-capital benefit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean precedent on this line for EG7; the Q2 cash beat (SEK 120.5m OCF) did not stop a -5.65% day.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced — pre-announced in the Q2 report — so it sits near zero; filed because a headline-reading algo will see negative OCF.
